# Grammar Database

The Grammar Database is a facility which enables users to readily find grammatical information on words in Irish, e.g. gender, inflected forms of nouns and how they relate to the definite article; tenses, moods and forms of verbs; forms and use of adjectives etc.

In the compilation of the Grammar Database, grammatical data was sourced from _WinGléacht_, from [focal.ie](http://www.focal.ie/) and from the New Corpus for Ireland, and was processed using the _Gramadán_ application to organise and adapt it systematically. Editorial staff then carried out a final proofing of the data.

## How to use

To look up the data for a word, simply type the word into the search box and click to display the grammatical information table. In addition to the main display, on the right of the screen is displayed an index of the neighbouring words for which there are grammar files in the Grammatical Database, while at the top of the screen an alphabetical index of the material is displayed.

## Grammar Wizard

Grammar Wizard is an interactive grammar engine which is based in the Grammar Database. It will help you combine prepositions, nouns and adjectives correctly. [More information...](https://www.teanglann.ie/en/_grammarwizard)

## Download

A free downloadable version of the grammar database is available under an open-source licence for those interested in using it in their own computational applications. [More information...](https://www.teanglann.ie/en/gram/_download)

## Future development

This is a live database. It is being developed in phases, the coverage and accuracy of grammatical data is being increased continually.
